crossRefs.note: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and king Josiah…
So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to…

people.name: Hadad-rimmon
people.line: A place near Megiddo associated with mourning for Josiah.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Megiddo
people.line: A strategic city in the Jezreel Valley

translations.web: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
translations.bsb: On that day the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
translations.kjv: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
translations.asv: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
